user.title: Connect to your Valerion projector
user.description: Enable AWOL Link on the projector first: All Settings > Inputs > External Inputs > AWOL Link. The projector must be switched on for this step.

data_description.host: The projector's IP address on your network. Give it a fixed address (DHCP reservation) in your router.
data_description.port: Leave at 4352 unless you changed it on the projector.
data_description.security_code: Only if you set a security code in the AWOL Link menu. Leave empty otherwise.
data_description.mac: Needed to switch the projector on from standby (Wake-on-LAN). Find it under All Settings > System > About > Status. Optional, can be added later.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the projector at this address and port.
error.awol_link_off: The projector refused the connection, so AWOL Link is switched off. Switch it on under All Settings > Inputs > External Inputs > AWOL Link, then try again.
error.invalid_auth: The projector rejected the security code.
error.projector_asleep: The projector accepted the connection but did not answer. Make sure it is switched on and that the Valerion app or VMote is closed, then try again.
error.invalid_host: This is not a valid IP address or hostname.
error.invalid_mac: This is not a valid MAC address (expected 12 hexadecimal digits, for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

projector_asleep.message: The projector did not answer. It is in standby or another app (Valerion, VMote) is connected to it.

command_rejected.message: The projector rejected {command} with {error}. ERR2 means an invalid value, ERR3 means the setting is locked for the current picture format.

power_on_timeout.message: The projector did not wake up in time: {error}

power_on_needs_mac.message: The projector is in standby and cannot be woken without its MAC address. Add the MAC address to the integration settings.
